title: NY woman’s 20-year apartment fight continues after court rejects landlord’s commercial lease claim
summary_full: A landlord's attempts to reclaim a Manhattan apartment are hindered due to ongoing claims about rent stabilization. E. Terese Carpenter has resided in the unit for over 20 years, despite the existence of a commercial lease. The appeals court identified unresolved issues regarding the actual use of the apartment and the landlord's awareness of the situation.
